runSummary.note: Real 16 Sep 17:39 sweep. Twelve independent source families were actually queried: Profesia, direct company/public careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Praca za rohom, Pretlak, Upwork, WordPress public jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. Strongest new BA candidate is TSS GRADE Asistent/ka pravneho oddelenia, published 14 Sep: Bratislava, 1,400 EUR, Slovak only, driver B, suitable for graduates, technical/economic background and one year practice. A fresh DHL Senec warehouse-admin listing also surfaced but is lower ranking. Upwork returned WooCommerce product-management work but the best operational listing is already three weeks old with 20-50 proposals. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable posts.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Candidate aging decay by source
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Apply source-specific decay to promotion priority: fast freelance marketplaces should lose urgency much faster than employer career pages, using proposals/interviews/hires and last-client-view signals where available.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Office skill evidence map
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Maintain evidence-backed proficiency for Word, Excel, Outlook and similar common tools from CV/project history, so listings asking for advanced Office can be scored consistently instead of receiving an arbitrary generic penalty.

policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data, job-sources or MASTER is attempted where full round-trip content cannot be guaranteed.
